chapter_summary: Ji Chenxi, despite his inexperience with real starships, is tasked with performing a critical FTL jump due to his S-class spiritual strength. He quickly adapts, executing daring maneuvers to evade the pursuing Red Scorpion pirates, led by their formidable deputy leader and a girl named Amis. After a tense chase and a last-second successful jump, Ji Chenxi proposes hijacking a top-tier personal ship to avoid detection. His crew reluctantly agrees, and he successfully intimidates the owner of the target ship into surrendering.

new_characters.description: A doll-faced girl with a cruel smile, part of the Red Scorpion pirate crew, assisting the deputy leader.

new_characters.description: The owner of a top-tier personal ship, who surrenders to Ji Chenxi's demands after being threatened.
